title: Question : How do you use queryParameters with url routing ?

comments.body:
Data will only appear in the URL if the custom widget has the following two life cycles too:

- `getWidgetState(uiState, { helper, searchParameters }): UIState` (merged with existing UIState)
- `getWidgetSearchParameters(searchParameters, { uiState }): SearchParameters` (merged with existing search parameters, usually using helper methods)

> https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/widgets/create-your-own-widgets/js/?language=js#the-widget-lifecycle-and-api

Oh, I need to upgrade to v3 for that, I'm still using v2. Any solution in v2 ?
I created the widget following the v2 guide https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/custom-widget.html
This should also work with v2, as long as you're using `routing`

Excellent ! It works well thank you, maybe it's necessary to complete the v2 documentation ? (maybe not, anyway v2 will soon be obsolete I guess)

Congrats to the team & community for this library, it rocks!

V2 documentation is indeed something we will no longer work on, but the migration to v3 should be fairly smooth: 

https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/upgrade-guides/js/#upgrade-from-v2-to-v3
